visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white striped button-down shirt, stands in a brightly lit room. Above her head is a floating digital grid of eight cartoon character icons. She smiles and moves her arms rhythmically to a beat while pointing at the camera. The background consists of shelves filled with cylindrical tea containers and merchandise. (2) A man in a black shirt enters the frame behind the woman, and they rotate positions. The man takes the center spot, looking focused as the grid of characters above his head changes. He wears a dark short-sleeved shirt and stands against the same shelf background. (3) A second man with glasses and a dark t-shirt joins the challenge. He moves with high energy, dancing and gesturing towards the character grid above. The camera remains static at an eye-level medium shot throughout the transitions. (4) The three participants continue to swap positions in a fast-paced montage. In several segments, they appear frustrated or laugh as a red border highlights different character icons in the grid above them, signaling their turn to name the character. (5) The video concludes with the first man speaking directly to the camera with a wide smile and expressive hand gestures. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the promotional merchandise on the wooden shelves in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy, rhythmic electronic dance beat begins with a strong kick drum. A female voice speaks in sync with the tempo, naming character names with a bright, enthusiastic tone. (2) A digital 'ding' sound effect marks a transition. A male voice takes over the rhythmic naming pattern, exhibiting slightly higher vocal strain as he attempts to keep pace with the increasing speed of the challenge. (3) Background laughter from other individuals is clearly audible under the main speech and BGM. The electronic synth layers in the music become more prominent. (4) A second male voice enters, shouting names with high arousal and volume. The audio is highly fragmented with rapid cuts between different speakers, all maintaining the same musical pulse. (5) The music continues at full volume until the end, concluding with a male voice shouting '這太難了' (This is too hard) with an exaggerated, comedic level of frustration and high pitch.
